command:
sudo test -f /etc/k0s/k0s.yaml
sudo k0s config validate --config /etc/k0s/k0s.yaml
sudo systemctl show k0scontroller --property=ExecStart
cat /home/ubuntu/qa-week1/curriculum/examples/telemetry/audit-policy.yaml
stdout:
ExecStart={ path=/usr/local/bin/k0s ; argv[]=/usr/local/bin/k0s controller --config=/etc/k0s/k0s.yaml --enable-worker=true ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[Tue 2026-09-08 14:16:19 UTC] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=471 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
omitStages: ["RequestReceived"]
rules:
  # Drop control-plane chatter
  - level: None
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["events", "endpoints"]
      - group: "coordination.k8s.io"
        resources: ["leases"]
      - group: "discovery.k8s.io"
        resources: ["endpointslices"]

  # Sensitive: log mutations, hide payloads
  - level: Metadata
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["secrets", "configmaps"]

  # RBAC: log everything
  - level: RequestResponse
    resources:
      - group: "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
        resources: ["roles", "rolebindings", "clusterroles", "clusterrolebindings"]

  # Token issuance: never record the returned bearer token
  - level: Metadata
    verbs: ["create"]
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["serviceaccounts/token"]

  # Interactive pod access
  - level: RequestResponse
    verbs: ["create"]
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["pods/exec", "pods/attach", "pods/portforward"]

  # Default
  - level: Metadata
